content.rendered:
During the Board of Directors’ Special Work Session on February 8, 2017, the bond owner’s representative, Rick Rainone of Cornerstone Management Group, Inc., presented to the Board members a list of projects that are scheduled to be completed in Summer 2017 with bond funds.  

Status on progress of the projects will continue to be shared with the Board, and we will add updates in the District Newsletter and on this web site as news comes available.

Overview

The Bond Management Team approved the following projects for construction in the summer of 2017.  The projects were selected based on emergency needs, immediate security needs, and other needed repairs and replacement.

Scope

  • Repair the sections of the roof that are leaking

Schools

Completed on time and completed budget?

  • Sherwood HS – Yes
  • Sherwood MS – Yes
  • Hopkins ES – Yes
  • Archer Glen ES – Yes

Scope

  • Renovation of entry vestibule and HVAC work

Schools

Completed on time and completed budget?

  • Middleton ES – Yes

Scope

  • Renovation of entry vestibule, chimney demolition

Schools

Completed on time and completed budget?

  • Hopkins ES – Yes

Scope

  • Renovation of entry vestibule

Schools

Completed on time and completed budget?

  • Archer Glen ES – Yes

Scope

  • Turf replacement, track replacement

Schools

Completed on time and completed budget?

  • Sherwood HS – Yes

Scope

  • Seismic assessment: Tier II evaluations for all buildings older than 1984

Schools

Completed on time and completed budget?

  • District-wide – Yes
